sources.snippet: This paper presents TimeCMA, an LLM-empowered framework via cross-modality alignment for multivariate time series forecasting. A cross-modality alignment module is designed to aggregate the time series and LLM branches based on channel-wise similarity retrieval to enhance forecasting.
